sceneConcept: A provisional design for a forty-six-year-old Chinese woman who runs a repair and scrapyard station stands alone against a transparent background. She has a stocky build, short messy brown hair streaked grey, brown eyes and a direct unsentimental expression. A faded dark green utility vest sits over a grey rolled-sleeve work shirt, charcoal cargo trousers, a broad tool belt and heavy work boots. Plain work gloves protect her hands, and one large adjustable wrench hangs loosely from her right hand. Soft even frontal studio light keeps her a mundane working proprietor. Visual refresh: patched industrial techwear with goggles at the neck, tool pouches and the damaged robot dog.
